patthana8.34:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca na sārammaṇo ca na anārammaṇo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
patthana8.34:2.1: na sārammaṇaṃ ca na anārammaṇaṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na sārammaṇañca na anārammaṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na anārammaṇo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na sārammaṇañca na anārammaṇañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sārammaṇo ca na anārammaṇo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
